newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 30,000/T March 1-5 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 30,000/T March 1-5 fuel oil.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of high sulphur fuel oil for delivery between March 1-5 to Bombay, sources said on Friday.
The tender to buy 180-centistoke, 3.5 percent sulphur grade fuel oil will close February 20 and is valid for one day.
India last purchased two cargoes of high sulphur fuel oil for delivery in February at between $10.48-$10.80 per tonne premium to Mideast quotes on a cost-and-freight basis.
